address: Yelaltı, Nur Dikmen Caddesi No:20, Urla, Izmir, 35430, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Once a butcher's shop, this establishment has evolved into a restaurant for meat lovers, and you can also purchase cuts to take home. The range is outstanding, in terms of both variety and quality. But come and see for yourself! Why not start with a few mezze, before moving on to the succulent lamb cutlets, or try the rump steak, marinated for a week in milk and herbs and cooked to perfection. There are small pots of spices on the tables, including cumin and oregano, so you can season your meat to your liking. Having said that, it is so exquisitely grilled that any sauce would really be entirely superfluous.
